name: facebookresearch_mcc/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_mcc/demo.py.run_mcc_demo: run the MCC demo to generate 3D occupancy predictions from an image and point cloud OBJ file
facebookresearch_mcc/demo.py.run_viz_predictions: run visualization to predict occupancy and colors for unseen 3D points using the MCC model
facebookresearch_mcc/demo.py.pad_image_tensor: pad a 3D image tensor to a square shape by zero-padding along the shorter dimension
facebookresearch_mcc/demo.py.normalize_point_cloud: normalize 3D point cloud coordinates by dividing by standard deviation and subtracting the mean
facebookresearch_mcc/demo.py.main_entry: run the main entry point that loads an image, point cloud, and segmentation mask to generate 3D predictions

facebookresearch_mcc/engine_mcc.py.run_train_one_epoch: run one training epoch of the MCC model with gradient accumulation and mixed precision
facebookresearch_mcc/engine_mcc.py.run_eval_one_epoch: run one evaluation epoch computing precision recall and F1 metrics for 3D point cloud predictions
facebookresearch_mcc/engine_mcc.py.run_run_viz: run visualization of MCC model predictions by generating HTML point cloud plots for a data loader
facebookresearch_mcc/engine_mcc.py.run_evaluate_points: run point cloud evaluation computing precision recall and F1 score between predicted and ground truth points
facebookresearch_mcc/engine_mcc.py.run_prepare_data: run data preparation for MCC training including point sampling augmentation and random flipping

facebookresearch_mcc/main_mcc.py.run_mcc_training: run the MCC model training loop on CO3D or Hypersim datasets with configurable epochs and batch size
facebookresearch_mcc/main_mcc.py.run_mcc_viz: run visualization inference on a trained MCC model using the --run_viz flag
facebookresearch_mcc/main_mcc.py.build_mcc_args_parser: build an argparse parser with all MCC training, model, and data configuration arguments
facebookresearch_mcc/main_mcc.py.build_mcc_data_loader: build a distributed PyTorch data loader for CO3D or Hypersim datasets with configurable batch size
facebookresearch_mcc/main_mcc.py.run_mcc_eval: run evaluation of the MCC model on the validation set every 5 epochs during training

facebookresearch_mcc/mcc_model.py.build_mcc_model: build an MCC masked autoencoder model using get_mcc_model with custom embed_dim and depth arguments
facebookresearch_mcc/mcc_model.py.run_forward_encoder: run the MCC forward_encoder to encode seen images and XYZ coordinates into latent features
facebookresearch_mcc/mcc_model.py.run_forward_decoder: run the MCC forward_decoder to predict occupancy and color for unseen 3D points
facebookresearch_mcc/mcc_model.py.create_preprocess_img: create a function to preprocess images by resizing to 224x224 and normalizing with ResNet mean and std
facebookresearch_mcc/mcc_model.py.run_shrink_points_beyond_threshold: run shrink_points_beyond_threshold to clamp 3D point coordinates beyond a given distance threshold

facebookresearch_mcc/submitit_mcc.py.run_multinode_training: run multinode MCC training on a SLURM cluster using submitit with configurable GPUs and nodes
facebookresearch_mcc/submitit_mcc.py.submit_training_job: submit a distributed training job to the SLURM scheduler via submitit AutoExecutor
facebookresearch_mcc/submitit_mcc.py.parse_args: parse command line arguments for multinode training including ngpus, nodes, timeout, and partition
facebookresearch_mcc/submitit_mcc.py.get_shared_folder: get or create a shared experiment folder under /checkpoint for the current user
facebookresearch_mcc/submitit_mcc.py.Trainer_checkpoint: create a DelayedSubmission checkpoint from the latest checkpoint file for job resumption
